model_interpretation.claim: The previous valid OpenMP candidate used a serial cutoff of 512 options per requested worker. Lowering the cutoff to 256 options per effective worker, while limiting the requested team to min(threads, n), tests whether parallelizing medium workloads pays off without creating idle workers or exceeding the passed CPU budget. The controller must measure the cutoff's overhead and any gain; no result is assumed here.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Factored the per-option formula into an inline helper used by both serial and parallel paths.","Added a static-scheduled OpenMP loop with num_threads(min(threads, n)) so the requested team does not exceed the supplied budget or the number of iterations.","Used a per-effective-worker cutoff of 256 options to retain the serial path for small workloads and contrast the prior candidate's larger work-grain assumption."]}

model_interpretation.claim: A guarded four-option SSE2 kernel may reduce per-option arithmetic overhead while keeping threading unchanged and preserving scalar logf/expf calls and the supplied CND coefficients. Its gain may be limited by those scalar math calls; the baseline remains the ordinary-loop comparison, and no speedup is claimed before measurement.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Added an explicit four-lane SSE2 Black-Scholes route selected by run when the frozen compiler target exposes SSE2.","Used unaligned vector loads and SIMD arithmetic for the per-option formula and CND polynomial while retaining scalar logf and expf calls.","Kept the original serial routine for unsupported targets and the vector loop tail; did not change threading or compiler flags."]}

items.subject: Combiner le parallélisme T1 et le noyau SIMD T2
items.objective: Partir du candidat T1, le plus rapide parmi ces sources mesurées, et y intégrer le noyau SIMD T2 sans perdre le budget de threads ni la couverture complète des sorties. Évaluer ce programme combiné avec le protocole inchangé; ne pas présumer que les gains s’additionnent.
